nature: Turbo is a deliberately aggressive, short fork of candidate 1 for the streamer showcase. It is NOT a controlled test: bonus, start mix and snapshot interval all change at once. Candidate 1 keeps running unchanged over the same frames as an informal A/B control.
fork: candidate 1 (bigclear-champ) newest full update checkpoint at launch: model, optimizer, sampler, retention baseline, adaptive lr and journal carried over (fork keys extended to start_mixes, showiness_bonus, checkpoint_every_frames)
pool_parent: the latest registered bigclear-champ snapshot at or before the fork frames

bonus.bound: tier plus horizontal caps (1.40) stay below the 2-point win/loss swing; the validator now enforces caps < 2 instead of < 1

start_mixes.natural: the rest of level-14 pairs; decision fractions reported from update 1

unchanged: retention hinge, 2048-row effective minibatch, KL-targeted lr (continues from candidate 1's current value), max_update_kl 0.03, parent-KL and retention guards
candidate_2: bigclear-armA paused at update 46 (99.0M frames), resumable from armA/core-u00046.pt; its f25/50/75M snapshots stay in the pool
reporting: style cumulative T1+ (>=27) / T2+ (>=30) / T3+ (>=42) per 100 placements; turbo vs candidate 1 over matched frames since the fork
